whatIs: 3D icons is a collection of more than 4,000 icons and characters in a 3D style, by Iconshock, with front and perspective views, five color palettes and a Figma file for changing the colors. It's organized into general icons, social media icons, characters and isometric icons.
It's a good fit when you want to give a landing page, an onboarding flow or a presentation a more illustrated touch without modeling anything in 3D.
uses: Illustrating the benefits sections of a landing page with 3D icons instead of flat icons.
Putting 3D social media logos in a site's footer or on a contact card.
Using a 3D character on an empty or welcome screen in your app.
caveats: For free you can only download PNGs at 72 and 128 px; larger sizes, up to 4,000 px, are premium.
These are rendered images, not 3D models, so you only get the front and perspective views each icon offers.
There are several paid packs and they're not all billed the same way (some are annual); check what each one includes before you buy.
pricingNote: Free download at 72 and 128 px; the full 4K pack costs $19, with a commercial license and no attribution.
idealFor: Landing pages and presentations that want 3D icons without designing them.
